result.explanation: Use a conditional rule tied directly to the first write: a successful first write must make its key the sole newest resident. This rejects the supplied mutations while remaining true for every applicable correct example.
result.mapping: The resident array is cache recency, entries carry value/version/dirty state, durable stores acknowledged values, and flushSeen records emitted version acknowledgments.
result.assumptions: Keys are lowercase strings and event fields follow the public contract. Unknown operation types are ignored with value null.
result.program: function solve(x){var c=x.config||{},e=x.event||{},s=x.state;if(!s)s={r:[],v:{},d:{},f:{}};var r=s.r,v=s.v,d=s.d,f=s.f,k=e.key,i=r.findIndex(function(a){return a.k===k}),a=i<0?null:r[i],status='ignored',value=null,flush=[];function touch(n){var z=r.indexOf(n);if(z>=0)r.splice(z,1);r.push(n)}function cleanSlot(){for(var j=0;j<r.length;j++)if(!r[j].dirty)return j;return -1}function add(n){if(r.length<c.slots){r.push(n);return true}var j=cleanSlot();if(j<0)return false;r.splice(j,1);r.push(n);return true}if(e.type==='write'){if(a){a.value=e.value;a.version=(v[k]||0)+1;v[k]=a.version;a.dirty=true;touch(a);status='written'}else{var n={k:k,value:e.value,version:(v[k]||0)+1,dirty:true};v[k]=n.version;if(add(n))status='written';}}else if(e.type==='read'){if(a){value=a.value;touch(a);status='hit'}else if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(d,k)){value=d[k];var n={k:k,value:value,version:v[k]||0,dirty:false};if(add(n))status='durable';else status='durable'}}else if(e.type==='flush'){if(a&&a.dirty){flush=[{key:k,value:a.value,version:a.version}];f[k]=a.version;status='flushed'}}else if(e.type==='ack'){if(a&&a.dirty&&a.version===e.version&&f[k]===e.version){d[k]=a.value;a.dirty=false;status='persisted'}}else if(e.type==='evict'){if(!a)status='missing';else if(!a.dirty){r.splice(i,1);status='evicted'}else status='blocked'}var dirty=r.filter(function(n){return n.dirty}).map(function(n){return n.k}).sort();var cached=r.map(function(n){return n.k});return{state:s,output:{status:status,value:value,flush:flush,cached:cached,dirty:dirty,durable:d}}}
